excluded_non_canonical.reason: unique frame outside the canonical campaign5 session set; not counted (CONTRACTS §11 canonical roots)

cnn.definition: BPSK recognition rate = counted normal-truth frames predicted BPSK / counted normal-truth frames. Normal rejection rate counts UNKNOWN. OFF rejection rate counts UNKNOWN on OFF-truth frames. No four-class real overall accuracy is computed.

baseline.gate: no rejection gate in CONTRACTS §9 (feature baseline)
baseline.definition: BPSK recognition rate = counted normal-truth frames predicted BPSK / counted normal-truth frames. Normal rejection rate counts UNKNOWN. OFF rejection rate counts UNKNOWN on OFF-truth frames. No four-class real overall accuracy is computed.

comparison.note: Feature baseline accepts every frame (no gate); its 'rejection' is only a label outside the four classes, which its contract does not produce.

statements.read_only_evidence: evidence/ was opened read-only; no file under evidence/ was created, modified, moved or deleted by this script.
statements.label_source: truth = trainval.truth (normal/off); transmission config = demod_result.submitted.config (BPSK/3Msym/s/RECT). No demod/model/environment output was used as a label.
statements.four_class_real_accuracy: NOT_RUN / prohibited: a four-class real overall accuracy cannot be computed from BPSK-only real truth and is not reported.
statements.single_real_config: The only real BPSK configuration is 3 MSym/s RECT at 60 MSPS with a 4096-sample snapshot; it is a single configuration, not a coverage sweep.
statements.interference_scenarios: Physical interference/impairment scenarios, if any exist elsewhere, are NOT included: no canonical per-frame manifest/evidence supports them in the scanned roots, so interference transfer is NOT_RUN.
statements.host_vs_arm: All inference is host CPU numpy; these results are NOT ARM and NOT board measurements and must not be reported as such.
statements.dedupe_rule: Frames are deduplicated by iq_sha256; equal hashes across campaign4/campaign5 are counted once at the first canonical path.
statements.independence: val-01 is the independent real session that participated in no threshold selection or tuning; it is reported first.

not_run: arm_inference: NOT_RUN - all inference in this report ran on the host CPU with the numpy runtime; these numbers are NOT ARM numbers and NOT board numbers.
board_hardware_accuracy: NOT_RUN - no board/hardware execution was performed by the evaluation tools.
azure_vm: NOT_RUN - no Azure connection information is available in this round.
four_class_real_overall_accuracy: NOT_RUN - not computed and prohibited by CONTRACTS §11; real truth exists only for the single BPSK-normal configuration and OFF scenes.
real_qpsk_qam16_qam64_frames: NOT_RUN - the canonical real sessions contain no QPSK/QAM16/QAM64 ground-truth frames.
real_quality_gate_population: NOT_RUN - no real gate_test population with OFF/NOISE/TONE/CLIP was collected; only OFF frames exist and are reported as OFF gate behaviour.

interference_physical_scenarios: NOT_RUN - no canonical per-frame manifest/receipt covering an interference physical scenario was included; such scenarios are absent from the canonical session set and are NOT_RUN, not silently folded into the BPSK transfer numbers.
gate_threshold_selection_on_real_data: NOT_RUN - forbidden by CONTRACTS §11; thresholds are selected on simulation val + gate_cal only, and val-01 is untouched by any selection.
demod_ber_derived_accuracy: NOT_RUN - demod BER exists on the board path but is not a model metric and is not used as a label or accuracy here.
limitations: Small real sample: 3 sessions x (10 normal BPSK + 1 off) = 30 normal + 3 OFF counted frames; one frame per listed file, no augmentation and no reuse.
Real BPSK has exactly ONE configuration in scope: fs=60 MSPS, BPSK 3 MSym/s RECT, LO=80 MHz, attenuation 46000 mdB, 4096-sample snapshot. Other symbol rates/shapings are NOT_RUN (no data).
OFF frames carry trainval.physical=false (no-signal scene); they are real board captures used only for OFF gate behaviour, never as class truth and never with a fake class label.
Board algorithm labels differ from the contract truth (several normal frames are labelled UNKNOWN/PULSE/CLEAR by the board algorithm); those outputs are ignored here, not converted into labels.
No clipped real frames were present in the canonical sessions, so real clipping rejection is NOT_RUN (simulation covers the CLIP gate kind).
Zero-shot transfer only: no real frame was used for training, validation or threshold selection (CONTRACTS §11); val-01 is the untouched independent real session.
Inference ran on the host CPU with the numpy runtime; these are NOT ARM numbers and NOT board numbers.

campaign4 and campaign5 duplicate frames were deduplicated by iq_sha256; the one unique campaign4 val-01 frame lies outside the canonical campaign5 session set and is excluded (listed with its reason), not counted.
